title: services step
description: Starts deps services, dbtest databases, supervised commands and seeded git repositories in declaration order; cleans up in reverse order.

services.description: A mapping of name to entry (declaration order is kept), or a list of entries each carrying a name.

duration.description: A Go duration such as 500ms or 2m.

dbtest.description: Lease PostgreSQL through commons-db/dbtest. The default database automatically configures child connection variables; multiple databases require exactly one default: true.

default.description: Configure standard connection variables for this database. Defaults to true for a sole database; false disables automatic connections.

dir.description: Directory of HCL/SQL migrations, relative to the effective fixture working directory.

name.description: Native migration metadata scope; omitted uses commons-db's default.

schema.description: Target PostgreSQL schema; omitted uses public.

variables.description: Typed JSON values supplied to native HCL variables.

deps.description: deps catalog service name, e.g. postgres.

runtime.description: deps: force a runtime; docker/helm use an ephemeral volume.

exec.description: Shell command; {{.port}} allocates a free port for this entry.

cwd.description: exec: working directory, relative to the fixture work dir.

tcp.description: host:port that must accept a connection.

commit.description: Record the files as one commit.

env.description: Extra environment for the service; also its env output.

wait.description: Readiness cadence (default interval 200ms, factor 1.5, max 2s, timeout 60s); deps entries take only timeout.

export.description: NAME: template over {{.outputs.*}}; "*": "{{.outputs.<map>}}" exports every key of a map output. Defaults <NAME>_URL and <NAME>_PORT.
